assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated EU5 topography attribute icon, matching the supplied reference sheet's antique hand-painted small terrain relief symbols. Viewed obliquely from above, compact bold silhouette, earthy ivory/tan with dark brown outlines and painted shadows; blue water only where specified. Must be readable at 30 pixels. Return one square PNG icon.
